entry_conditions: Supports the FULL assigned expanded slices, including aligned open descent, closing at a source, attached lifting, carry, insertion, release and retreat. Supply two causal measured observations: qpos/qvel, world-metre TCP and red/blue poses with wxyz quaternions, and both world goals. Supplied fixture boxes must match the open tray. Finger width is qpos[7]+qpos[8]; an approximately 0.080 m width is observed at expanded starts, with source cube center z about 0.020 m and TCP z across starts about 0.0877-0.1779 m. Closed width near 0.0365 m, a close TCP-object relation and subsequent co-motion support an attachment inference, not a contact measurement. No index or time is required to enter, and these measured ranges are not hard rejection thresholds.
exit_conditions: Separate formal task success from manipulation readiness. The contract accepts both objects fully contained in their own rotated-xy regions with center z within 0.011 m of 0.036 m, without requiring release or clearance. A useful manipulation exit additionally follows demonstrated detach/settling and open-hand vertical retreat. In demo10300 red is near z 0.0457 m with fingers closed at 280, then at z 0.036 m with opening fingers at 290; continuing to 414 leaves red still packed, fingers about 0.080 m open and TCP about [-0.4049,0.2598,0.2677] over blue. Final blue continuation to 741 leaves both packed and an open TCP near [-0.1494,0.0735,0.3165]. These are observed routes, not certified arm-safe states or mandatory task-success poses.
overlap_role: All valid actions in all expanded segments receive diffusion supervision. For demo10300 the shared 75:182 and 445:562 intervals teach open source descent, closing, lift and the beginning of transport; 265:415 teaches final red lowering, opening/detach, settling, vertical retreat and open traversal toward blue. Demo10307 has corresponding 72:178, 439:552 and 259:408 overlaps. The geometry prior's learned modes avoid applying free-carry height requirements indiscriminately to pickup or insertion. A two-state history distinguishes descending open approach from rising attached payload and from a stationary packed cube under a rising open TCP. The policy is not restricted to a trimmed high-carry core.
successor_readiness: Pass actual measured history and inferred active/pending color, whether attachment remains plausible, the other block's pose/containment status, current opening trend, TCP-object offset and motion direction. Do not pass predicted clearance or a geometric containment flag as proof of detach. For an early handoff during lowering or opening, the successor must retain insertion/release and vertical retreat competence; it must not immediately traverse sideways with a plausibly attached payload. At a late red exit the open overhead blue approach supports acquisition takeover; at the final open retreat there may be no pending block. The learned forward does not export a certified mode or contact signal; the selector must reason from measured state.
failure_signatures: Observed or predicted cube bottoms/corners close to a rim during lateral carry; payload descent while outside the tray opening; packed red moving during blue packing; closed fingers with lost TCP-object co-motion; rising TCP while the intended cube remains at the source; mismatch between predicted and observed object motion; or a low open TCP traversing laterally before retreat. Geometrically clear TCP/cube predictions can still coincide with arm or gripper collisions. Ensemble agreement is not a success or safety certificate. Such failures are reasons to reassess measured state, not evidence of a supported automatic recovery mode.
continuation_guidance: Continue through source approach/closing/lift when takeover occurs in the incoming overlap. Continue carry and aligned insertion until measured goal containment; if useful for the next skill, continue demonstrated release and upward retreat before lateral traversal. Finger opening, object remaining near z 0.036 m, loss of object/TCP co-motion and rising TCP support this continuation decision. If red is packed and blue remains at the source, the trained outgoing slice continues the open approach toward blue; the selector should transfer to acquisition when appropriate rather than extrapolate delivery indefinitely beyond its learned exit. If both containment predicates hold, the formal task is complete even before nominal release/retreat. Invocation duration is selected from state, not a fixed demonstration-time schedule.
limitations: Observed support is not learned-policy performance. Attachment/contact is inferred from finger width, relative pose and motion; the dataset has no contact labels. The fixed epsilon-only inference interface runs ordinary DDPM, not multi-sample rollout ranking. The assigned geometry-ranking idea is implemented as a confidence-weighted training preference through supervised action-conditioned pose models. Side-wall buffers, weak mode labels and conservative rotated-cube envelopes are unvalidated engineering choices. No IK, full robot collision model, continuous swept-volume check, runtime fixture perception, calibrated uncertainty, changed-geometry guarantee or off-demonstration recovery is implemented. Only the supplied aligned open tray is observed.
